# signoz_role (Resource)

Manages a SigNoz custom role (`/api/v1/roles`). Only `description` is mutable after create (PATCH). `name` changes force resource replacement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name. Changing this value replaces the resource. Managed roles cannot be created via this resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Role description. Default: omitted (empty string). This is the only field updated on apply after create.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was created. Read-only.
- `id` (String) SigNoz-assigned UUID. Read-only.
- `org_id` (String) Organization UUID. Read-only.
- `type` (String) Role type from the API. Read-only. Valid values: `custom`, `managed`.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was last updated. Read-only.
